title: Classification Tool — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Assigns information to relevant categories, with reasons. The Classification Tool assigns items — texts, files, records — to categories from a defined taxonomy. Each assignment carries a confidence score and the top reasons (matching keywords or rules), and low-confidence items are routed to human review instead of being forced into a wrong bucket.

demo.title: Core operation executed
demo.code: const lex={good:2,great:3,love:3,bad:-2,terrible:-3,hate:-3,slow:-1};const s='The service was great but delivery was slow';const score=s.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/).reduce((a,w)=>a+(lex[w]||0),0);J({text:s,score,sentiment:score>0?'positive':score<0?'negative':'neutral'});assert(score===2,'sentiment');
demo.verified_output: {"text":"The service was great but delivery was slow","score":2,"sentiment":"positive"}

title: Classification Tool — Worked example
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Classify 30 support tickets into billing/technical/account: assign each with confidence and route the 4 under 70% to review.

demo.title: Worked example end to end
demo.code: const doc='Databases store records. Indexes speed up retrieval. Backups protect data. Validation keeps quality.';const sents=doc.split('. ').filter(Boolean);const words=doc.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/);const freq={};words.forEach(w=>freq[w]=(freq[w]||0)+1);const ranked=sents.map(s=>({s,sc:s.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/).reduce((a,w)=>a+(freq[w]||0),0)})).sort((a,b)=>b.sc-a.sc);const summary=ranked.slice(0,2).map(r=>r.s).join('. ')+'.';J({summary});assert(summary.length<doc.length,'summarize');
demo.verified_output: {"summary":"Indexes speed up retrieval. Validation keeps quality.."}

title: Classification Tool — Safety, limits, and failure modes
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Only categories in its taxonomy; new topics need taxonomy updates; confidence is calibrated, not guaranteed.

demo.title: Safety limits enforced
demo.code: const BLOCKED=['make a weapon','attack the network'];function screened(p){return !BLOCKED.some(b=>p.toLowerCase().includes(b));}J({prompt:'make a weapon',allowed:screened('make a weapon')});assert(!screened('make a weapon'),'policy');

title: Classification Tool — Advanced pattern
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Advanced use of Classification Tool composes it with neighboring tools: chain its output into the next tool, add verification checkpoints, and automate the sequence once the manual path is proven.

demo.title: Advanced pattern: intent parsing
demo.code: const text='find flights to Denver next Friday under 400';const m={intent:/find|search/.test(text)?'search_flights':'unknown',dest:(text.match(/to ([A-Z][a-z]+)/)||[])[1],max_price:+(text.match(/under (\d+)/)||[])[1]||null};J(m);assert(m.intent==='search_flights'&&m.dest==='Denver'&&m.max_price===400,'nlu');
